name: Goliath
hint: A giant from Gath who challenged Israel's army for forty days.

name: Abraham
hint: God changed his name to one meaning 'father of many nations.'

name: Moses
hint: Named because he was 'drawn out' of the water.

name: David
hint: A shepherd boy anointed by Samuel before he became king.

name: Paul
hint: A tentmaker and missionary who wrote letters to young churches.

name: Peter
hint: A fisherman whose name means 'rock.'

name: Noah
hint: His name sounds like the Hebrew for 'rest' or 'comfort.'

name: Samson
hint: A Nazirite whose strength was tied to his uncut hair.

name: Delilah
hint: A woman of the valley of Sorek, paid by Philistine rulers.

name: Esther
hint: Her other name was Hadassah.

name: Judas Iscariot
hint: One of the Twelve who kept the money bag.

name: Lazarus
hint: A man of Bethany whose sisters sent word that he was ill.

name: Zacchaeus
hint: A short man who climbed a sycamore tree to see someone pass.

name: Egypt
hint: A land along the Nile where Joseph rose to power.

name: Jerusalem
hint: A hilltop city David captured and made his capital.

name: Bethlehem
hint: Its name is usually understood to mean 'house of bread.'

name: Nazareth
hint: A small Galilean town where a carpenter's family settled.

name: Jericho
hint: A walled city whose fall followed seven days of marching.

name: Eden
hint: A garden planted 'eastward,' where a river divided into four.

name: Sodom
hint: A city Abraham pleaded for, asking about fifty righteous people.

name: Capernaum
hint: A lakeside town described as 'his own city.'

name: Babylon
hint: A great Mesopotamian city where Israel's exiles were taken.

name: Galilee
hint: A northern region around a lake that Jesus visited often.

name: Gethsemane
hint: A garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives; its name is usually linked to an olive press.

name: Manna
hint: A bread-like food that appeared with the morning dew.
refs: OT: Exodus 16:31; NT: John 6:31, Hebrews 9:4, Revelation 2:17

name: Nehemiah
hint: A royal cupbearer who led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

name: Elijah
hint: A prophet from Tishbe who confronted Baal's prophets on a mountain.
note: The KJV New Testament spells it 'Elias.'

name: Isaiah
hint: A prophet whose name is usually understood to mean 'the LORD saves.'

name: Ezekiel
hint: A priest-prophet who saw a valley of dry bones.

name: Jonah
hint: A prophet who ran toward Tarshish.

name: Daniel
hint: An exile in Babylon who interpreted a king's dreams.

name: Haman
hint: An Agagite promoted by King Ahasuerus.

name: Mordecai
hint: A Benjamite who sat at the king's gate in Susa.

name: Barnabas
hint: His name means 'son of encouragement.'

name: Timothy
hint: A young coworker from Lystra.

name: Priscilla
hint: A tentmaker who, with her husband, explained the way of God more accurately to a gifted speaker.

name: Nicodemus
hint: A Pharisee who visited by night.

name: Boaz
hint: A landowner of Bethlehem who showed kindness to a gleaner.

name: Rahab
hint: A woman of Jericho who hid two spies on her roof.
refs: OT: Joshua 2:1-6; NT: Matthew 1:5, Hebrews 11:31, James 2:25

name: Naaman
hint: A commander of Aram's army who was told to wash seven times.

name: Melchizedek
hint: A king of Salem and priest of God Most High.

name: Balaam
hint: A seer from Pethor whose donkey spoke to him.
refs: OT: Numbers 22:5, 22:28; NT: 2 Peter 2:15, Jude 1:11, Revelation 2:14

name: Gideon
hint: A judge who tested God with a fleece.

name: Mount Sinai
hint: Where Moses received the tablets of the Law.

name: Mount Carmel
hint: A mountain where fire fell on a soaked altar.

name: Damascus
hint: A Syrian city on the road where a persecutor was blinded by light.

name: Philippi
hint: A Macedonian city where a jailer asked what he must do to be saved.

name: Patmos
hint: An island where a vision was received.

name: Passover
hint: A feast marking a night when the destroyer passed over.

name: Goshen
hint: The region of Egypt where Jacob's family settled.

name: Nineveh
hint: A capital that repented at a prophet's short warning.

name: Methuselah
hint: Genesis gives his age as 969 years.

name: Enoch
hint: A man who 'walked with God' and was no more, for God took him.

name: Joel
hint: A prophet who wrote about a plague of locusts.

name: Hezekiah
hint: A king of Judah who showed Babylonian envoys his treasures.

name: Josiah
hint: A king of Judah, crowned as a boy, who found the Book of the Law.

name: Habakkuk
hint: A prophet who cried out 'How long, LORD?'

name: Obadiah
hint: A prophet whose book is the shortest in this part of the Bible.

name: Ezra
hint: A priest and scribe skilled in the Law of Moses who returned to Jerusalem.

name: Gehazi
hint: A prophet's servant who coveted a foreign commander's gifts.

name: Zerubbabel
hint: A governor of Judah who led a return from exile and laid the temple foundation.
refs: OT: Ezra 3:2, Haggai 1:1; NT: Matthew 1:12, Luke 3:27

name: Mount Moriah
hint: The region where Abraham was told to offer Isaac.

name: Mount of Olives
hint: A ridge east of Jerusalem that David climbed weeping.

name: Tarshish
hint: A far-off destination a fleeing prophet tried to reach by ship.

name: Sychar
hint: A Samaritan town near Jacob's well.

name: Bethany
hint: The village of Mary and Martha, near Jerusalem.

name: Emmaus
hint: A village where two travelers recognized a stranger when he broke bread.

name: Antioch
hint: A city where disciples were first called Christians.

name: Mount Zion
hint: A fortress David captured and called the City of David.

name: Joppa
hint: A seaport on the Mediterranean coast.
refs: OT: Jonah 1:3, 2 Chronicles 2:16; NT: Acts 9:36, Acts 10:5

name: Gaza
hint: A Philistine city whose gates were carried off to a hilltop.

name: Tarsus
hint: A city in Cilicia, the hometown of a famous apostle.

name: Frankincense
hint: A fragrant resin burned with grain offerings.

name: Hyssop
hint: A plant used to apply blood to doorposts.
refs: OT: Exodus 12:22, Psalm 51:7; NT: John 19:29, Hebrews 9:19

name: Leviathan
hint: A sea creature described in God's speech from the whirlwind.

name: Jesse
hint: A Bethlehemite with eight sons, the youngest a shepherd.

name: Obed
hint: A son born to a Moabite widow and her second husband.

name: Salmon
hint: A name in the family line leading to Boaz.

name: Gamaliel
hint: A respected teacher of the law who advised a council to leave the apostles alone.
note: The same name belongs to a leader of Manasseh in the wilderness census (Numbers 1:10).

name: Simeon
hint: A righteous man in the temple who took a baby in his arms.
note: The name is also borne by a son of Jacob and Leah.

name: Zechariah
hint: A prophet who saw visions of a lampstand and olive trees.
note: The NT priest in Luke 1 shares the name (KJV: Zacharias).

name: Eleazar
hint: A priest, son of Aaron, who succeeded his father.

name: Rehoboam
hint: Solomon's son whose harsh answer split the kingdom.

name: Perez
hint: A twin son of Judah whose birth involved a scarlet thread.

name: Nahshon
hint: A leader of Judah during the wilderness years.

name: Shem
hint: One of the three sons who survived the flood with Noah.

name: Terah
hint: A father who set out from Ur toward Canaan but stopped at Haran.

name: Lamech
hint: A man who boasted of avenging himself seventy-sevenfold.
note: Two different Lamechs: Cain's descendant (Genesis 4) and Noah's father (Genesis 5, Luke 3).

name: Theophilus
hint: A name usually understood to mean 'friend of God,' addressed by a historian.

name: Epaphras
hint: A faithful servant who prayed hard for the Colossians.

name: Onesimus
hint: A runaway slave sent back with a letter.

name: Eutychus
hint: A young man who fell from a window during a very long sermon.

name: Bartholomew
hint: Listed among the Twelve, paired with Philip in the lists.

name: Jehoiada
hint: A priest who protected a hidden boy-king for six years.

name: Zephaniah
hint: A prophet active in the days of King Josiah.

name: Mephibosheth
hint: Jonathan's son, lame in both feet after an accident as a child.

name: Ichabod
hint: A baby named 'no glory' after the ark was captured.

name: Nabal
hint: A wealthy sheep-owner of Carmel whose name means 'fool.'

name: Shibboleth
hint: A word that exposed those who could not pronounce it.

name: Peniel
hint: Jacob named it 'face of God' after wrestling.
